heading: INT. BOTANICAL CONSERVATORY, AFTER CLOSING - NIGHT

units.text: INT. BOTANICAL CONSERVATORY, AFTER CLOSING - NIGHT
A cathedral of glass and iron.
Palms rise into the dark like columns.
Condensation drips from the vaulted panes.
A path of wet slate winds between orchid beds, and a single lamp near the fountain draws a small circle of gold in the green gloom.
Five people stand in the circle, looking at the water.
PROFESSOR HENRIETTA VAN DER MEULEN-ASANTE (60s) holds a clipboard against her chest like a shield.
Beside her, DR. IGNATIUS BELLAMY-OJO (50s) polishes his spectacles on his tie.
DOROTHEA "DOT" KWESI-PEMBERTON (30s, gardener's overalls) stands with her arms folded.
Across the fountain, SUMNER HALE-ABIOLA (40s, security uniform, flashlight) shifts his weight.
And at the edge of the light, the youngest, CELESTINE OYELOWO-STRAND (20s, a notebook against her hip), is writing.
Someone moved the orchid.
units.name: HENRIETTA

units.text: It's not an orchid, Professor. It's a hybrid.
units.name: DOT

units.text: Dorothea, I do not need a lecture.
units.name: HENRIETTA

units.text: Henrietta, please. We're all tired.
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: I locked the east door at nine.
units.name: SUMNER

units.text: And the west?
units.name: CELESTINE

units.text: West too.
units.name: SUMNER

units.text: Then how did it leave the building?
units.name: HENRIETTA

units.text: It didn't.
units.name: DOT

units.text: Silence.
A drop falls from the glass into the fountain.
Ripples spread.
Dorothea, what do you mean?
units.name: IGNATIUS

units.text: I mean it's still here.
units.name: DOT

units.text: She points.
At the base of the tallest palm, in the shadow beyond the lamp, something small and pale lies in the soil.
The roots of the palm have curled around it like a fist.
That's impossible.
units.name: SUMNER

units.text: It's not impossible. It's what it does.
units.name: CELESTINE

units.text: Celestine?
units.name: HENRIETTA

units.text: It's a hunter. It leaves, then it comes back for what it wants.
units.name: CELESTINE

units.text: Dot unfolds her arms.
Ignatius puts on his spectacles.
Sumner raises the flashlight, and its beam swings across the glass, across the palms, and settles on the pale thing at the roots.
It is a human hand.
